subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should become the canonical fix path for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but several open PRs overlap the same root cause and differ in whether they fix the native macOS fallback path, gateway-side detection, or only the visible error.

options.title: Review and land the strongest macOS fallback PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate once it has current-head real macOS app proof and maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Choose another linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use another open linked PR if it proves a cleaner owner-boundary fix, stronger upgrade behavior, or better real app proof.

options.title: Ask for a replacement if candidates stall
options.body: Keep the issue open and create a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot become landable.

recommendation.title: Review and land the strongest macOS fallback PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate once it has current-head real macOS app proof and maintainer acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent history on the native macOS dashboard and gateway endpoint surface where the canonical fix should land.
